decisions.question: Does project canon define the Flying Spaghetti Monster's gender/sex category as 'carbohydrate', or only permit that joke as community/editorial language?
decisions.current_article: States that Pastafarian communities recognize male/female/carbohydrate and that the Monster is carbohydrate.
decisions.external_evidence: Henderson commonly uses masculine English pronouns; other Pastafarian material includes mixed/beyond-male-female framings; no checked source establishes exactly the saved three-category rule.
decisions.action_when_corpus_ready: Align wording to corpus; do not retroactively label a project choice as external community doctrine.

decisions.question: Which created processes continue autonomously, and which require continuing direct intervention by the Monster?
decisions.current_article: Chemistry/biology and many systems can continue after initiation; gravity is presented as requiring continuing Noodly intervention.
decisions.external_evidence: General Noodly gravity has external Pastafarian support; the broader autonomy model is project-specific.
decisions.action_when_corpus_ready: Reconcile metaphysical model without changing calendar mechanics unless corpus explicitly connects them.

decisions.question: Is gravity implemented by a personally allocated Noodly Appendage per person/object, or is that merely explanatory elaboration?
decisions.current_article: Uses a personal-appendage model for people and speculates about stones.
decisions.external_evidence: Official/Church material supports being pressed down by Noodly Appendages, not the saved detailed allocation model.
decisions.action_when_corpus_ready: Keep source core; align detailed mechanics to project canon.

decisions.question: Is a carbohydrate component canonically required for a proper Pastafarian meal?
decisions.current_article: Yes; it presents a proper meal as requiring a carbohydrate source.
decisions.external_evidence: Pasta/carbohydrate emphasis and anti-low-carb satire are strong; Loose Canon also tolerates people who cannot/will not eat pasta.
decisions.action_when_corpus_ready: Decide whether the stronger meal rule is intentional project canon.

decisions.question: What exactly is the Anti-Past/Antipasti in project canon and which saved details are binding?
decisions.current_article: Named antagonist, lord of diets, low-carb substitutes, weaker body, fewer appendages, can be driven off with one appendage.
decisions.external_evidence: Loose Canon directly supports Anti-Past, Foul Lord of the Diets, ersatz soy-meat balls, temptation and one-Noodly-touch defeat; several saved details go beyond the located source.
decisions.action_when_corpus_ready: Adopt source core plus only project additions actually chosen by canon.

decisions.question: Does project Hell specifically serve antipasti instead of pasta?
decisions.external_evidence: Checked Loose Canon Hell passage instead says residents are separated from Pasta / never eat Pasta; familiar Beer Volcano/Stripper Factory belongs to Heaven.
decisions.action_when_corpus_ready: Treat saved sentence as project-specific choice, not external-source summary.

decisions.question: What happened after the cooking-accident Flood: repair, residual geological evidence, or other consequences?
decisions.current_article: Monster stops flood, repairs enough damage for life to continue, leaves geological/historical traces.
decisions.external_evidence: Cooking-accident Flood core is Gospel-supported; the repair/residual-evidence details are not yet externally sourced.

decisions.question: Is the broader 'work, forgetting and repairs / layered legacy systems' model canonical?
decisions.external_evidence: Forgotten duplicate land is Gospel-supported; the generalized engineering/legacy-system cosmology is project-created.
decisions.action_when_corpus_ready: Determine which generalizations are canon and which remain editorial metaphor.

decisions.question: Are everyday signs / answered prayers ontological canon, or deliberately bad epistemology examples only?
decisions.current_article: Written in direct factual voice while structurally illustrating selective evidence.
decisions.external_evidence: Prayer/devotional material exists externally; the specific evidence-accounting scheme is project-written.
decisions.action_when_corpus_ready: Preserve deliberate epistemology function without accidentally canonizing every example as historical event.

decisions.question: How does the new canonical corpus reconcile with the previously approved concrete ontology of Odin, Thor and Loki?
decisions.current_article: Not present in the saved 2026-09-16 draft. Later user-approved material required a concrete ontological opening: Odin is real but not omniscient; Thor is linked to storms/lightning; Loki is a shape-shifter; gods can be limited, mistaken, quarrelsome and defeatable.
decisions.external_evidence: Norse mythology independently supports limited/vulnerable divine figures; this verifies the comparative premise, while the project's assertion that these figures are literally real was a separate prior project decision.
decisions.action_when_corpus_ready: Treat the prior ontology as an existing decision to reconcile, not as an undecided blank. If the corpus differs, the corpus wins and the public article is updated accordingly.

decisions.question: Does project canon affirm any specific relation between physical mechanisms and divine agency?
decisions.current_article: Later approved discussion added the principle that describing a mechanism does not by itself rule out an agent.
decisions.external_evidence: This is a logical distinction, not an external Pastafarian fact.
decisions.action_when_corpus_ready: Preserve mechanism/agency distinction; do not infer agency merely from existence of a mechanism.

decisions.question: Is 'wishful thinking as overt epistemic activism' project canon, editorial philosophy, or an appendix-like joke?
decisions.current_article: Later approved material exists but is not in the saved 229-line draft.
decisions.external_evidence: Project concept; one exact sentence recovered.
